command:
set -eo pipefail
cd /tmp
echo "== cdo builds an ETOPO field + a constructed constant field; nco independently verifies =="
cdo -f nc -topo,global_2 topo.nc 2>/dev/null
CMAX=$(cdo -s output -fldmax topo.nc 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')
CMIN=$(cdo -s output -fldmin topo.nc 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')
ncwa -O -y max -v topo topo.nc nmax.nc 2>/dev/null; NMAX=$(ncks -s '%g' -H -C -v topo nmax.nc 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' \n')
ncwa -O -y min -v topo topo.nc nmin.nc 2>/dev/null; NMIN=$(ncks -s '%g' -H -C -v topo nmin.nc 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' \n')
cdo -f nc -const,288,global_2 c.nc 2>/dev/null
MO=$(cdo -s output -fldmean c.nc 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')
cdo -s remapbil,global_5 c.nc cr.nc 2>/dev/null
MR=$(cdo -s output -fldmean cr.nc 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')
cdo -s -addc,12 c.nc c12.nc 2>/dev/null
MA=$(cdo -s output -fldmean c12.nc 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')

fail=0
row(){ printf "%-26s %s  [%s]\n" "$1" "$2" "$3"; if [ "$3" = FAIL ]; then fail=1; fi; }
eq(){ awk -v a="$1" -v b="$2" -v t="$3" 'BEGIN{d=a-b;d=d<0?-d:d; exit !(d<=t)}' && echo ok || echo FAIL; }
{
row "cross_tool_max"   "cdo=$CMAX nco=$NMAX want 5761 (ETOPO/2deg)"      "$(eq "$CMAX" "$NMAX" 0.5; )"
row "cross_tool_max_val" "$CMAX vs known 5761"                          "$(eq "$CMAX" 5761 0.5)"
row "cross_tool_min"   "cdo=$CMIN nco=$NMIN want -8979"                  "$(eq "$CMIN" "$NMIN" 0.5)"
row "cross_tool_min_val" "$CMIN vs known -8979"                         "$(eq "$CMIN" -8979 0.5)"
row "conservation_regrid" "const fldmean $MO -> $MR (want 288)"          "$(eq "$MR" 288 1e-6)"
row "exact_arithmetic" "const+12 fldmean=$MA (want 300)"                 "$(eq "$MA" 300 1e-6)"
} | tee smoke-check.txt
grep -q FAIL smoke-check.txt && { echo "SMOKE CHECK FAILED" | tee -a smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED" | tee -a smoke-check.txt
